title: Deputy Uses Taser to Apprehend Armed DUI Suspect Running from Crash Scene
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Volusia County, Florida — On November 30, 2024, while helping out the DeLand Police Department on a hit-and-run crash, Deputy Darcy with the Volusia Sheriff's Office heard a Live 911 call for a second crash. When she got on scene of the second crash, the suspect took off running. After a foot chase and several Taser deployments, 37-year-old Timothy Woulard Jr. was taken into custody. He had the keys to the hit-and-run suspect vehicle in his pocket along with several yellow rocks that tested positive for fentanyl. Deputy Darcy also recovered a loaded handgun Woulard dropped while running. Woulard was found to be on probation for homicide (manslaughter with a firearm). He was charged with violation of his probation (no bond) in addition to his new charges of DUI with damage, leaving the scene of a crash, possession of a firearm/ammo by a convicted felon, carrying a concealed firearm, resisting without violence, and possession of a controlled substance.
